تُستخدم ملفات ارتباط أساسية للجلسة والمص: Basic cookies are used for session, authentication, trainee access token, and language preference. No advertising analytics. Recording exercise performance is optional within the trainee's account.
الاسم والإيميل والجوال الاختياري، العمر: Name, email, and optional mobile phone, age or date of birth, gender, height, and trainee status, programs, exercises, and movement explanation videos, nutrition and meal goals, macro recording, weights, measurements, and fat percentage, class performance and weekly reviews, progress photos that the trainee chooses to upload, correspondence and trainer notes, packages, freezing, and payment history. Sharing measurements and photos is optional.
لتقديم برنامج المتدرب ومتابعة الوزن الذي: To deliver the trainee's program, track the weight he chooses to share, and organize his subscription and payments. You can log in with a verified account or with a dedicated trainee link with an access code from the trainer. Keep the link and code and do not share them with anyone who is not intended.
لا توجد رسائل آلية أو مزامنة خارجية أو A: There are no automated messages, external sync, AI, or payment gateway. Uploaded videos are saved in a special container and playback links are temporary; External video links go to their location by choice. Upload QR is valid for 15 minutes for one video. The trainee link is valid for 180 days and the trainer can stop and change it; Its content speaks when the program is published. The coach himself decides to send any WhatsApp message.
التصحيحات تضيف سجلًا وتحتفظ بالقيم الساب: Corrections add history and retain previous values ​​for review; Removing daily weight does not erase its historical version. Archiving stops access and saves records for restoration. Explicit deletion request removes profile, programs, metrics, goals, reviews, correspondence, coach notes, invitations, and disables links. Progress images are deleted from storage with a list to retry when a file cannot be deleted. Shared trainer videos are not automatically deleted by deleting a single trainee. Financial figures and audit records remain anonymous; Retention periods and the mechanism for deleting authentication accounts, videos, and backups need to be reviewed before actual operation.
قالب التغذية يحافظ على اسم البرنامج وأيا: Nutrition templates preserve the program name and training days and require an existing program. Use the trainee profile for standalone targets.
اسم اليوم والتمرين والمجموعات والتكرارات: Name of the day, exercise, sets, reps, and rest required
الافتراضي: 3 مجموعات · 10–12 تكرار · 90: Default: 3 sets, 10–12 reps, 90 seconds rest. Adjust after adding.
معدات النادي، وقت الحصة المتاح، تفضيلات: Club equipment, available class time, meal preferences…
The coach manages their trainees' information within his account. The identity of the operator, its address, the data processor and the channel for privacy requests need to be identified and reviewed before launch.
المدرب على بيانات متدربيه فقط. المتدرب ع: The coach only uses their trainees' data. The trainee receives his published programme, his feed, his subscription, his records, his measurements, his photos and his correspondence. Drafts, the coach's own notes, and other people's data are not available to him. Links to photos and videos are private and temporary. In Supabase mode the data is stored in the selected project area; The area and therapists are reviewed prior to launch.
